Specification: This module defines an animation-oriented refinement of the EWD840 token-ring termination detection specification by adding an auxiliary history variable that records the most recent visible event, especially message sends with sender and receiver information. It reuses the underlying algorithmic actions from EWD840, constrains initialization for animation purposes, and builds SVG structures that visualize node state, token position and color, and recently sent messages. The module also defines an animated temporal specification with weak fairness for the system part and an invariant that bounds the exploration depth once termination is detected, in order to obtain interesting simulation traces.
